But now something was pushing me harder than all that weight could hold me down.

en.html: Kill people. Build peace on top of their bodies. That was the road I had chosen for myself. And I was still only partway along it. The disasters that began with the incident two years ago were still in the world. Countless people dying in countless conflicts, countless wars. Not finished yet. My mission—◆no.◆ My own purpose. That was still unfulfilled.
en.text:
Kill people. Build peace on top of their bodies.
That was the road I had chosen for myself.

And I was still only partway along it.

The disasters that began with the incident two years ago were still in the world. Countless people dying in countless conflicts, countless wars.

Not finished yet.

My mission—◆no.◆
My own purpose. That was still unfulfilled.

ja.html: 人を殺し、その骸の上に平和を築く。 　それが俺の選び取った道。 　俺はその道の、まだ半ばにいる。 　二年前の事件に起因する災いは今なお世界に残り。 　無数の対立、無数の争乱の中、無数の人々が死んで いる。 　まだ・・、終わっていない・・・・・・・。 　俺の使命――◆違う。◆ 　俺の目的・・はまだ、果たされていない。

en.html:
What use would it be, coming from me? A murderer with the smell of blood still on him was not going to persuade people.

That, surely...
Somebody else, somewhere, would do it.

Somebody would offer a prayer without that stain on it.

For me, my own way.
A much inferior method was available.
